en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘For Salāt, there are four thousand limits’. And in another report: ‘For the Salāt, there are four thousand doors (chapters)’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Salah (prayer) has four thousand limits (rules).”’
“In another Hadith it is said that in Salah (prayer) there are four thousand doors (chapters).”
